tracks.title: What Stays
tracks.description: Outro — o que fica depois do testemunho. Suave, sem moral.
tracks.prompt: Contemporary organic-electronic, AwakeSoul. Warm female vocals with poetic lyrics. Soft synth pads, piano, subtle percussion, strings. Intimate, contemplative, transformative. No autotune. Clean vocal production. 70 BPM, signature element: intimate whisper close-mic, no afrobeats no afropop no amapiano no tropical. Lyrics in English. Sacred but not religious, body-centred, breath as prayer. intimate, contemplative, vulnerable. intimate whisper close-mic. Theme: Outro — o que fica depois do testemunho. Suave, sem moral..
tracks.lyrics:
[Vocal: ONE warm mezzo-contralto female voice, intimate speaking quality, slight breathiness on sustained notes, sings very close to the microphone, layered airy harmonies emerging only on choruses (3 voices max — root, third, fifth), no melisma, no belting, no riffs, no autotune]
[CRITICAL: subtle international English accent, NOT American, NOT exaggerated British]
[Persona: Loranne — contemporary organic-electronic, AwakeSoul lineage, contemplative and transformative]

[Intro: solo felt-piano, soft pad bed, room tone, breath audible, no drums]
[Verse 1]
The storm is gone
The house still stands
Not pretty, not the same
But standing
The roof has different shapes now
The walls remember water
And I — I am the woman
Who didn't move when she could have
[Verse 2]
There is no big lesson here

No bow on the ending
Just the small fact of breath

the woman who noticed

Notas de revisão (vs. versão anterior)
Track 4 reescrita de “One Inch” (EN) para “Cinco Passos” (PT). Saiu o registo de
coach (“brick by brick”, “small geography of being okay”). Nova metáfora física:
passos da cama à janela. Mantém PEAK 1 da estrutura.
Track 8 reescrita de “Flicker” (EN, chama outra vez) para “Batimento” (PT, ritmo
cardíaco). Resolve a repetição da metáfora da chama nas tracks 1, 5, 8.
Bridges reescritas em todas as tracks que fechavam com moral. Agora abrem
fissura — sem “the miracle is…”, sem “thank yourself like a doctor”.
Track 9 (Cá Estou) reposicionada para 2ª pessoa testemunhal. Volta = “voltei para
mim”. Cá Estou = “cá estou para ti que ainda não conseguiste”. Diferenciação clara.
Distribuição PT/EN atinge 6 PT / 4 EN (vs 5/5 anterior) — mais coerente com
Loranne pós-AO90 como base.
Prompts Suno com mais atrito (vinyl crackle, room tone, tape saturation, faint
street ambience) sem comprometer clareza.
